beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It hasn't rained in a week. So why is there a puddle in the middle of this road?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: One extra line in a forbidden scroll. One archive. And a boy who has read every mission report the Leaf ever filed, including the one about this puddle.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sensei. It hasn't rained in a week.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: I know. Keep walking.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Rewind four seconds. Naruto and Kakashi spot the puddle in the very same second. In canon, two ninja wait in a puddle exactly like this one, on a road where it hasn't rained in days.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Neither of them breaks stride. Kakashi sets the pace. Naruto drops back one step, and a rock beside the road quietly turns out to be a clone.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Why are you walking like you're carrying a full bowl of soup?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Casual. I'm being casual.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: That's the worst casual I've ever seen.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Is it safe to stop? My feet hurt.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Keep walking, Tazuna. Slowly. Like nothing's wrong.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The puddle explodes. Two ninja in torn cloaks, one spiked chain between them, and Kakashi is wrapped up before anyone can blink.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: They tear him into four pieces. Sakura screams. Tazuna goes the color of old paper.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Kakashi-sensei!

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It's a log. Look at the cut. There's bark on it.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, is it my turn yet?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The brothers split. One lunges at Tazuna. The rock stops being a rock and takes the chain in the stomach. Pop. Naruto grunts, and keeps the memory of the hit.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Ow. Sasuke, the other one's coming from the left!

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: I see him.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke slides in low and sweeps the brother's legs. Sakura plants herself in front of Tazuna, kunai in both fists. Naruto sits on the second brother before he lands.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Nobody touches him. Nobody!

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Nobody has ever said that about me before.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Chunin of the Hidden Mist, tied up in under a minute. Not bad at all.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Do I get a medal? I took a chain for you.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: The rock gets a footnote.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Tazuna. Two chunin knew which road we'd take. That isn't a C-rank. Start talking.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Gato. He owns every ship in the Land of Waves. My bridge would put him out of business.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: We couldn't pay for a higher rank. Nobody in my village could. So I called it a C-rank, and I hoped.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In canon, Tazuna lies about the mission rank. He pays C-rank prices and walks a team of children into a fight that was never a C.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You paid for a C-rank, old man. I've filed the price sheet.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: An ambush by ninja is a B-rank at least. That's four times the price. Don't worry, I'm not mad. I'm just writing it down.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Four times? We don't have that. We barely have a bridge.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: We can't just leave him, Kakashi-sensei.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Hn. We're already here.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Fine. The mission continues. Naruto and Tazuna can discuss the invoice later.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody sends just two chunin. Somebody's sending a third.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: They cross the strait in a rowboat, engine off, oars wrapped in cloth. The mist is so thick Sakura can't see her own hand.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, I'm up the mast. I can't see anything either.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: That's fine. Nobody can. That's the whole problem with mist.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Please don't tip the boat. I can't swim.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Quiet. Row.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then something large spins out of the fog. A sword the size of a door buries itself in a tree, and a man in bandages lands on the hilt like it's his front porch.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Zabuza Momochi. The Demon of the Hidden Mist.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: Kakashi of the Sharingan. Hand over the old man, and I'll let the brats walk.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Afraid the paperwork's already signed.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi lifts his headband. A red eye opens beneath it, three black marks spinning. Zabuza smiles behind the bandages. He's been waiting for this.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then Zabuza dissolves into mist, and the mist closes around Kakashi like a fist. Water gathers into a sphere. Kakashi is inside it, and Zabuza's hand is the lock.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: The Water Prison. Nobody breaks it. Run, brats. Take the old man and run.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Run! Take Tazuna and get out of here!

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: We can't leave you in there!

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: He's too strong. We can't even see him.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I read four reports about this jutsu. Four. Every one of them says the same thing.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He can't move while he holds it. The prison needs his hand. That's not a weakness. That's a handle.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: So we make him let go.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Windmill shuriken, Sasuke. Just like the bell test. Except this time, I'm the second one.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: Children's tricks. I've killed grown men who tried tricks.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke throws a windmill shuriken, wide and loud. Zabuza snatches it out of the air. Hidden in its shadow is a second one, and that one isn't steel.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In canon, Naruto turns into a shuriken against Zabuza here in the Land of Waves. This time the only person surprised is Zabuza.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Did that boy just turn into a throwing star?

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Yes. You'll get used to it.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: A shadow inside a shadow!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Zabuza ducks the second shuriken. To do it, he has to move. And to move, he has to let go of the water.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The prison bursts. Kakashi drops to the sand, gasping. Naruto lands beside him, human again, a kunai held in his teeth.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: That won't work twice, brat.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: It's not borrowed. It's mine.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: He did it to me first. At the bell test.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: That's the thing about a trick you invented. It works even when they know it's coming. They just watch the wrong shuriken.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Now Kakashi is free, and the Sharingan reads Zabuza a half second early. The Demon of the Mist is losing to his own sword. Then two needles whisper out of the trees.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: They sink into Zabuza's neck. He drops without a sound, and the whole shore goes silent.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Thank you for your help. I've been hunting this one for a very long time.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Then the Hidden Mist has our thanks.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The masked hunter-nin lifts Zabuza onto his shoulder and turns to go. A hunter-nin destroys the body on the spot. Kakashi realizes that too late, in canon, after the masked boy is already gone.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Hey. Wait a second.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Page four. Real ones burn the body.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The masked boy stops. For one second, nothing moves on the shore. Then he's a flicker of mist and a footprint, and the body goes with him.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: He's right. Hunter-nin of the Mist destroy the body at once. Zabuza is alive.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi works it out one heartbeat later. Zabuza is alive, and the Leaf knows it a full week early.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then Kakashi's good eye closes and he drops to one knee, chakra empty. Sakura gets there first. He's out before she can say his name.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Sensei! Naruto, help me!

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Is he dead?

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: He's tired. There's a difference. Mostly.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: A week for him to get up. A week for Zabuza to heal. So I've got a week.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi sleeps for three days. Tazuna's bridge is a third built, with eleven workers left, and Naruto counts them twice.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Eleven men. At that rate it's done by winter.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Eight months, if Gato's thugs leave us alone. They won't.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Eight months. Okay. That's a number I can work with.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Three hundred orange kids pile out of the mist carrying more lumber than the village has seen in a year. The foreman faints. A clone catches him.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Just how many of you are there?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Yes. All of us.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, where do the beams go?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Up! Where else would beams go?!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, we ran out of nails.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Then use the other nails! The ones we have!

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. Clone sixty says the bridge is crooked.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Which way?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Up. Definitely up.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss, I fell in the water.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I know! I just felt it! Stop falling in the water!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Every four minutes, a clone falls off something. Every four minutes, Naruto is damp. By lunch, he gives up on being dry.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Here's the arithmetic. Three hundred clones, ten hours a day, six days. Eighteen thousand hours of labor. Gato's plan needed this bridge to take months.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And rule two never sleeps. So ten clones pop at the top of every hour, and the tiredness drips in like rain instead of falling like a roof. He's always tired. He's never flattened.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: You look terrible.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I feel amazing. Everything hurts, but amazing.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On day three, Kakashi limps out of bed with a lesson plan. Tree walking. Naruto raises a hand. Night one, a hundred clones, forty trees, one very annoyed owl.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: You already did tree walking.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Night one. Sasuke and Sakura did it by the second night. Ask them!

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: I did it by lunch.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: I did it before breakfast. You were asleep.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Fine. Then I'll teach you something harder. How to fight inside mist.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: In mist you can't trust your eyes. So you put eyes where the enemy isn't looking.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sentries! Clones on every beam! Oh. Sorry. Did you finish?

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: No. But you're right.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke trains until his hands blister. Sakura learns one job and learns it well. The client stays alive.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Nobody touches Tazuna. Not even a mosquito.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Is there a mosquito?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Meanwhile, a small boy in a bucket hat watches from the dock. Inari has watched them work for four days. He hasn't spoken once. Today he does.

beats.speaker: INARI
beats.text: Why do you keep doing this? Gato's going to kill you. Heroes don't exist.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Wow. That's the fourth time you've said that.

beats.speaker: INARI
beats.text: Because it's true! People who try, die!

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I know. I've read what happens when nobody comes. Whole shelves of it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Look. I know what it's like when nobody shows up. So I'm not going to be nobody for you.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Inari watches a boy who simply will not stop. Day five. The hammer never slows. On the sixth morning, he picks up the other end of a plank.

beats.speaker: INARI
beats.text: You're holding it wrong.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Huh? Oh. Thanks. Hey, you're good at this.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The last plank drops at sunset, months ahead of anyone's plan. Naruto sits down on it and is asleep before the hammer stops ringing.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Across the strait, a very rich man has just lost months of leverage. He doesn't know it yet.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the fourth day Naruto slips into the woods for one quiet minute. There are light steps behind him. Even. Weight on the toes.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nobody ever walked toward him, so he learned everyone who walked away. He's heard these steps once before, on the shore, the day a masked boy carried off a body.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You can come out. You're really quiet. That's how I know it's you.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: You heard me. Most people don't.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A boy about his age kneels in the ferns, a basket of herbs in his lap. No mask. Hair tied back. A gentle face that hasn't decided whether to be afraid.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: You're not what I expected.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody says that after the first minute. It's a whole thing.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: My name is Haku.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Naruto. You knew that already.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: These are for someone who is hurt. He's been hurt a great deal.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: I know who you picked them for. I know who you carried off that shore.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Then why aren't you shouting?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Because you carry herbs the way Iruka-sensei carries my lunch. Careful. I know that kind of careful.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Do you have someone precious? Someone you would do anything to protect?

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: A teacher with a scar across his nose. An old man who gave me a desk. And a lot of me.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Then you understand. When a person has someone to protect, that is when they become truly strong.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Yeah. I think I do.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: He is the only person who ever needed me. Without him I am nothing.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: That's a terrible thing to believe. I used to believe it too. Then somebody stayed.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: On the bridge, I will not hold back.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Neither will I. But I'd like you standing at the end of it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Haku disappears into the ferns with his basket. Naruto kneels where he is for a long while. He has just met someone as alone as he used to be, and he'll have to fight him anyway.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Back on the second day, Naruto found the easiest way into a shipping company. Get delivered. Nine ledgers arrive at Gato Shipping in a returned crate. Nobody remembers ordering them. Accountants never check.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Nobody sneeze. We're books.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Books don't have noses.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: He's reading me. Upside down. Why is he reading me?

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Because that's how I'd read us!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In the corner office, a short man in a small white suit counts coins that belong to other people. Two bodyguards guard the coins.

beats.speaker: GATO
beats.text: Where did these ledgers come from?

beats.speaker: GATO
beats.text: We have a returns department? Fire him.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: We're so good at this.

beats.speaker: GATO
beats.text: The bridge takes months. By the time it's finished, Zabuza will have killed that old fool, and the whole country will owe me.

beats.speaker: GATO
beats.text: And when Zabuza's done, my men finish him. Write it down. Zabuza Momochi. Disposal. No payment.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: An accountant opens the nearest ledger and writes it in ink, directly on the page. The clone beneath the page feels the nib. It tickles.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In canon, Gato never meant to pay Zabuza. He planned to have him killed the moment the job was done. This time, someone has it in writing.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: At midnight the nine clones pop in a line, and a whole accounting department's memory comes home in one headache.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sakura. I need you to read something.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Why me? Sasuke can read.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: I read fine.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You read quiet. Sakura reads loud. If Zabuza ever stops listening to Kakashi, I need someone to stand there and read him page nine at the top of her lungs.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: That's the dumbest plan I've ever heard. Fine. I'll do it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the last night he writes his report, the way he writes all of them now. At the bottom he signs, and in the margin there is a small crooked bowl of ramen. He doesn't notice he's done it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi notices. He reads the page twice. He looks at the margin for a long time and says nothing. Then he folds the page very carefully, like it might break.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Zabuza will come at dawn. He's had his week. So have we.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Can't sleep. I've got three hundred clones to hide in buckets.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Dawn. The bridge is finished, wet with mist, and the whole crew has been sent home. Naruto has not been idle. Three hundred clones stand on it as rope coils, planks, buckets, and one lunchbox.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Tazuna waits at the far end with Sakura. And out of the white walks a man with a sword the size of a door.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: Kakashi. You look well for a man who was on the floor.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: You look well for a dead man.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: Haku. The little ones are yours.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Yes, Zabuza-sama.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Kakashi and Zabuza vanish into the fog. Steel rings on the left, then the right. You can't see either of them, but you can hear who's losing.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Haku steps between two boys. The air goes cold. Ice mirrors rise in a dome around Naruto and Sasuke, and each one shows a masked face.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Ice. Great.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: I don't want to hurt you. But I will.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He steps into one mirror, and he's in all of them. Needles rain down from every angle. Sasuke steps in front of Naruto and takes it across his arms, his chest, his back.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Stay behind me.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sasuke! Your arms!

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Don't you dare. I'm fine.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Just watch the mirrors. Tell me what you see.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Whoever stands in front takes the pain. It's an old mistake.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He's too fast. He's faster than one pair of eyes.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He can't be faster than a thousand.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Batches of ten. It was the first rule he ever made. Three hundred clones at once is the one thing he swore he'd never do. He's about to do it on purpose.

beats.speaker: KURAMA
beats.text: Three hundred memories at once, brat. Your skull is not that big.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Then it only has to hold for three seconds.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: You can't be faster than a thousand eyes!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Three hundred clones pop at once. Every shadow clone returns its memory, and three hundred copies of the same three seconds come home together. In canon, nobody tells Naruto that until he's sixteen.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: From the rafters, the rail, the planks, the lunchbox. Three hundred angles on one dome of ice. Eight mirrors only copy Haku. One is where the boy actually stands. From the inside that's invisible. From out there, it's the only thing that moves.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Sasuke! Third from the rail! The one with the chip in the top corner! That's him!

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The tiredness of three hundred clones arrives all at once. Naruto folds like a dropped coat.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Dead last. You idiot.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sasuke's eyes burn red. The Sharingan, awake for the first time. In a dome of identical ice, one boy has been told exactly where to look.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He ignores the needles. He throws one kunai, at the mirror Naruto named. The ice cracks open and a masked boy drops out of it, bleeding.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Impossible. Nobody finds the true mirror.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: He did it.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Out in the fog, Sakura holds her ground beside Tazuna. Blades crash. Kakashi's hand crackles with blue light.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: Is it over? Please tell me it's over.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: No. Stay behind me. I'm not done.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Sakura makes up her mind. She opens the page she's carried for two days, steps out from behind Tazuna, and reads.

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: Gato Shipping, ledger nine! Zabuza Momochi! Disposal! No payment!

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: He's going to have his men kill you once the job's done! It's in his own books!

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: What did you say, girl?

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Zabuza's sword stops. It's the first time it has stopped all morning. He takes the page she holds out and reads it for himself. Gato's seal. His own name.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: But Kakashi's Lightning Blade is already running. Haku, bleeding, throws himself between them to protect his master.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: Hold it, Kakashi. Not him.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: I'm already stopping.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Lightning Blade stops one hand's width from Haku's chest. Blue sparks crackle against a cracked mask. And Zabuza's blade is lowered.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: Read the rest of it, girl. Out loud.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then slow applause rolls across the bridge. Gato arrives at the head of a hundred hired swords, in a small white suit, and finds a very finished bridge.

beats.speaker: GATO
beats.text: Six days? Six days?! It was supposed to take months!

beats.speaker: GATO
beats.text: Zabuza! Why are these children still breathing? I'm not paying you to talk!

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: You aren't paying me at all. Page nine.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A hundred hired swords look at the Demon of the Hidden Mist, then at each other, then at the very long walk home. They run. Gato runs faster. Nobody has ever crossed a bridge quicker.

beats.speaker: ZABUZA
beats.text: We're done here. I don't fight for free. Haku, we're leaving.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Yes, Zabuza-sama.

beats.speaker: HAKU
beats.text: Tell the boy he saw true. Tell him thank you.

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: Hn. Tell him yourself. Later.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Zabuza and Haku walk back into the mist alive. A page of Gato's ledger blows across the bridge, read by everyone who needed to.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Naruto misses all of it. Nineteen hours later he wakes in Tazuna's house, with a seagull on his chest.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: In canon, clone fatigue stacks on the user, all at once. Fifty clones for an hour was a warning. Three hundred is a bill.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Ugh. Why is there a seagull on my chest?

beats.speaker: SAKURA
beats.text: It's been there since noon. We named it.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Did it work? Is everybody alive?

beats.speaker: SASUKE
beats.text: I hit it. Don't make it a thing.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: Everyone's alive. That includes Zabuza and Haku.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: My Lightning Blade stopped a hand's width from Haku. Zabuza had already read Sakura's page.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: He read it. Good.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Nobody burned a body this time.

beats.speaker: KAKASHI
beats.text: No. Nobody did.

beats.speaker: TAZUNA
beats.text: The bridge is finished. The whole country has crossed it twice. We'd like to name it after you.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Great! Call it Ichiraku!

beats.speaker: INARI
beats.text: It's already painted. The Great Naruto Bridge.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Three days later the team is home, and the paperwork is waiting. A cat report. And a stack of Chunin exam registration forms taller than Sakura.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He signs the first one with a quick flourish. In the margin, a small ramen bowl appears. Nobody mentions it.

beats.speaker: CLONE
beats.text: Boss. This guy's failed the exam seven times.

beats.speaker: NARUTO
beats.text: Seven? Nobody's that bad at anything. Pull his file.

cards.title: A PUDDLE ON A DRY ROAD

stamps.label: CANON
stamps.note: It had not rained in days.

stamps.label: CANON
stamps.note: Paid for a C-rank. It was not.

stamps.label: CANON
stamps.note: He does this in the Land of Waves.
